purpose_context: This Wave A mission wraps the Zig service in a private-by-default single-administrator operational envelope. It owns offline bootstrap/recovery, opaque sessions, default-deny authorization, CSRF, TLS reverse-proxy deployment, container hardening, persistent-path permissions, graceful shutdown, checkpointed backup, and fresh-target restore. It consumes P0 Draft contracts for planning only and owns no invoice, client, project, rendering, scheduling, or reporting behavior.
purpose_tldr: Secure the single-admin application, private deployment, durable shutdown, offline backup, verified restore, and recovery paths.
